description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Guac & Marshmallow Pizza by paying {G}.
When Guac & Marshmallow Pizza enters, it triggers, giving Devoted Druid +2/+2 until end of turn and untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid using the ability granted to it by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Guac & Marshmallow Pizza from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
